# Cristian Urbano

> Lead software engineer with 15+ years building digital products. Specialized in AI Agents, Workflows and Platforms, and in Developer Experience, owning the full Product Cycle from idea to launch. Deep technical craft with a human-centered eye.

Cristian Urbano is a lead software engineer based in Bariloche, Argentina. Roles: Tech Lead & Architect, AI Engineer & Automation, Full-Stack TypeScript. Works in English and Spanish.
